disposition: Reject all five replay prototypes. Variant03 preserves end-of-frame sound state and source-dated lists, greatly reducing spacing error, but regresses opening video in both regions. Variant04 drifts in NTSC; variant05 faults in NTSC. Variants01/02 do not reach PSG startup.
source_api_change: Caller-owned timed workspace APIs reuse existing timed semantics; old APIs remain wrappers. Fast/master compositions are named separately. Production does not select these APIs and rebuilds byte-identically.
next_action: Deliver source-dated events without synchronously waiting in the video IRQ. Establish preparation deadlines and first-write physical phase. Existing raw replay seed-to-entry clock sampling bounds must include rebasing and burst classification overhead; do not merely increase waits to hide faults.
limits: No production bug fix or new public ROM claimed.
No absolute phase or PCM equality.
Compact32-channel/64-IRQ staging is a rejecting diagnostic bound, not proof of full-game capacity.
Source full-vector checks run on host; physical replay probes run native68000 in emulator.
